skill.summary: Summarize URLs or files with the summarize CLI (web, PDFs, images, audio, YouTube).

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Summarize skill.
- Summarize URLs, local files, images, audio, PDFs, and YouTube links via CLI.
- Supports multiple AI models (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI) with configurable API keys.
- Includes flexible output flags: control length, output format, extraction mode, and more.
- Optional config file and API keys for advanced extraction and YouTube transcription.
